message: Detected SQL statement that is tainted by req object. This could lead to SQL injection if the variable is user-controlled and not properly sanitized. Use parameterized queries instead.
Found a non-literal user-supplied string passed to a database query. Possible SQL injection via string concatenation.
Detected potential reflected XSS. User-supplied input from req.query is interpolated directly into an HTML template without escaping.
User-controlled data rendered into HTML response without escaping. Potential reflected XSS vulnerability.
Detected path traversal. req.params data flows into path.join without validation. An attacker can use ../ sequences to read arbitrary files.
Found non-literal argument to path.join. User-supplied filename could enable directory traversal if not validated.
A hardcoded JWT secret was detected. This secret can be extracted from your source code and used to forge JWT tokens.
Hardcoded secret value detected in JWT signing configuration. Secrets should be loaded from environment variables.
Detected hardcoded password. Hardcoded credentials should never appear in source code.
Hardcoded password string found in source. Credential should be managed via a secrets store.
Detected use of js-yaml with DEFAULT_FULL_SCHEMA. This schema allows arbitrary JavaScript objects to be instantiated during deserialization.
User-controlled property key used in object access without type checking. Could allow NoSQL injection attacks.
Unvalidated redirect destination. URL parameter is passed directly to res.redirect without allowlist validation.
Detected XML parsing with external entity processing enabled. This allows XXE attacks that can exfiltrate local files.
XML parsed with external entities enabled. The noent true option allows XXE attacks that can read local files.
Basket ID from request path is used in database query without ownership check. Allows unauthenticated basket access.
Detected use of Math.random for security-sensitive CAPTCHA generation. Math.random is not cryptographically secure.
Math.random is not suitable for generating unpredictable values in security-sensitive contexts such as CAPTCHA.
Detected use of MD5 hashing algorithm. MD5 is considered cryptographically broken.
Use of MD5 cryptographic hash. MD5 is weak and broken for security use cases; replace with SHA-256 or bcrypt.
HTTP request made to a user-supplied URL without host validation. Allows SSRF to reach internal services.
Detected potential prototype pollution. Properties are merged from src into target without filtering __proto__ or constructor.
Detected SQL statement that is tainted by req object. This could lead to SQL injection.
Detected inclusion of a third-party script. Ensure the source is trusted and consider using Subresource Integrity hashes.
User-supplied quantity parameter used as object key. Could theoretically allow property injection on the order model.
Sensitive field password is stored in the model schema. Ensure the field is hashed and never returned in API responses.
